reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly claims carbon increases stacking fault energy to enable TWIP/TRIP in BCC alloys; interstitial carbon in BCC refractory alloys typically reduces ductility and promotes embrittlement, not TWIP/TRIP mechanisms which are characteristic of FCC alloys.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with specific measurements and a well-defined falsification criterion based on strength drop, plasticity improvement, and carbide detection.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (TWIP/TRIP in BCC) that is fundamentally unsound for this alloy system, and carbon addition is well-known to embrittle refractory high-entropy alloys.
